title: Alpha School Internal Data Reveals Gaps in 'A.I.-Driven' Marketing
summary:
Journalist Dana Goldstein published an investigation into Alpha School that reveals the network's internal learning and enrollment data for the first time. The report alleges a disconnect between the school's "A.I.-driven" marketing claims and the reality of its internal operations.

The disclosure comes as the school network expands its reach into the public education sector.
